text: ひま　つぶしに　たたかいを　いどんで　くる　ひとも　いるかも

structure.jp: たたかいを　いどんで　くる　ひとも
structure.en: people who come at you with a challenge to battle, too

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is the short spoken form of かもしれない, which says something is possible but not sure. いるかも = 'there might be'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action comes toward you. いどんで　くる = 'come and challenge you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかいを　いどんで　くる　ひと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a noun tells you which one is meant. たたかいを　いどんで　くる　ひと = 'people who challenge you to a battle'.
